dropped.item: Exercises described as 'easy-to-follow' and that you 'always' know what to do
Premium unlocks additional app features ('to unlock more of what the app has to offer') and the 'Upgrade' call to action
Purpose of progress sharing: 'keep your recovery moving'

changed.item: Progress sharing changed from user-initiated ('Let your physical therapist see') to a passive statement that the PT can see your progress. The actor and control shift from user to PT.
PT adjusting the plan changed from a purpose enabled by sharing ('so they can adjust') to a flat statement that the PT adjusts it ('and adjust your plan'), which is slightly more certain

added.item: Claim that each exercise comes with a clear video. The original's '300+ video exercises' broadly supports this, but the intro did not originally tie every exercise to a video.
